summary: Turkcell Iletisim Hizmetleri A.S. filed a Form 6-K announcing a financing bond issuance of TRY 500 million (nominal) maturing September 25, 2026, with annual simple interest of 40.25%, sold via private placement to qualified investors in Turkey on June 24, 2026. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation. The bond is a short-term (93-day) fixed-rate bill, listed domestically, with no public offering or exchange listing. No premium or strategic event is involved. The filing reflects normal funding activity under the TRY 15 billion limit approved by the Capital Markets Board.
